---
name: Feature request
about: A use case or capability that Printable does not yet support
---

Describe the task you want to complete, the current obstacle, and an example of
the desired result. Explain how you would verify success and any constraints
such as model size, printer requirements, latency, or file format.

Mention existing tools or workarounds you tried. A proposed implementation is
optional; the use case and acceptance evidence matter most.
